newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway's Nera applies for Singapore listing.
newsitem.headline: Norway's Nera applies for Singapore listing.

text.p: Norwegian telecommunications group Nera ASA said on Tuesday it had applied for a listing on the Singapore stock exchange.

The company said it would prepare a private offering of shares directed towards the investor in Singapore. It will hold an extraordinary meeting to increase the share capital to a minimum 250,000 and a maximum 500,000 shares on December 18.
Nera said about 40 percent of its sale and order intake was derived from the Asian market, in which 20 percent of its employees are located.
The company is present in Singapore, Malaysia, the Philippines, Thailand and Vietnam.
